answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 12378 Country: India Title: asssalam o alaikum, i want to know that minimum how much length of dadi (chehra) is allowed. Question: asssalam o alaikum, i want to know that minimum how much length of dadi (chehra) is allowed. Answer ID: 12378 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 699/699=M/1430) It is wajib to grow beard to at least one fist size. The Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) said: خالفوا المشرکین وأوفروا اللحی (متفق علیہ) وفي الدر المختار: یحرم علی الرجل قطع لحیتہ والسنۃ فیھا القبضہ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
